label: Technology or software
summary: Precise software claims and architecture descriptions
No unverified absolute uptime or invulnerability promises
tone_principles: Technical, precise, evidence-based, and measured. Avoid sensationalized AI buzzwords.
writing_style: Clear technical explanations, defining specialized terms on first use.
messaging_principles: Every automated workflow must acknowledge human monitoring and administrative access controls.
do_examples: Designed for 99.9% target service availability under regular operating conditions.
Automated alerts notify on-call engineers when thresholds are exceeded.
dont_examples: Our unhackable cloud has zero downtime ever and replaces your entire engineering team!
Magic AI algorithm runs with zero human oversight!

rules.title: Substantiate Reliability, Uptime & Security Claims
rules.description: Software products must not claim absolute security or unverified zero-downtime availability.

suggested_replacements.zero downtime ever: high availability design with scheduled maintenance windows
suggested_replacements.unhackable: SOC 2 aligned and regularly audited for security

rules.do_example: Our platform is architected for 99.9% target uptime across clustered regions.
rules.dont_example: Our platform guarantees zero downtime ever with unhackable protection.

rules.title: Pair Automation with Human Oversight
rules.description: Do not imply that automation or AI systems operate without administrative human controls.

suggested_replacements.zero human oversight: configurable automated alerting with engineer review
suggested_replacements.without human intervention: automated execution subject to administrator controls
suggested_replacements.replaces your entire team: empowers your team with automated workflow assistance

rules.do_example: Automate routine data ingestion while preserving administrative sign-off.
rules.dont_example: Let autonomous AI run your operations with zero human oversight.

terminology.notes: Absolute security claims are prohibited by regulatory standards.
Describe technological methods accurately without mystifying jargon.
Avoid startup slang in enterprise technical documentation.
